Near the Naltar Powerhouse. Video. From Ejaz: An avalanche was triggered this morning in Nalter Payeen, Naltar Valley. No damages or losses were reported due to the avalanche mitigation work implemented by AKAH in 2022. Before the intervention, the nallah in the area was narrow and incised, which increased the risk of avalanche overflow toward nearby settlements. The mitigation measures improved and widened the channel, allowing the avalanche debris to pass safely through the nallah. This event demonstrates the effectiveness of the mitigation work in reducing avalanche risk and protecting the community.
